_doc: D021a + D022 classification config. Rules are tried in order; first match wins. Excludes are checked before rules. Overrides (by exact path) take precedence over everything.

rules._comment: D022: plugins/ is the canonical home for shipped plugins. Drops the lazysite- prefix; installed under DOCROOT/../plugins/ to match manager-api's @CANDIDATES search path.

Core CGI scripts stay at repo root with the lazysite- prefix. processor, auth, manager-api, dav, mcp, oauth are explicitly enumerated so a future stray lazysite-*.pl at root won't get silently installed to cgi-bin.
SM289: per-path access from a shell, beside the users tool it complements.
SM079: shared Lazysite::* modules. Installed beside tools/ and plugins/ at DOCROOT/../lib; the modular scripts add it to @INC via a relative use-lib bootstrap. The processor does not depend on it.
Public shared assets served at /assets/ (docroot root, no auth) - e.g. the bundled qrcode.js used by the 2FA QR and the ::: qr content component. Code bucket so upgrades refresh them.
Built-in content components (::: qr, ...) available on any layout via the templates fallback in the processor.

SM201: engine-required system pages (login/claim/402/403/404) served with a fallback - a content-root or docroot-root copy overrides, else this protected default. Code bucket (refreshed every upgrade, DAV-blocklisted so an agent cannot delete it). Precedes the general starter/*.md seed rule so it is NOT seeded as an editable root page.

Manager CSS/assets must be web-served at /manager/assets/ (the /lazysite/ tree is Apache-denied). Ship them straight there via the manifest - code bucket, so an upgrade always refreshes them - instead of the old install.pl copy hack, which left a stale manager.css on upgrade. This rule precedes the general lazysite/manager rule (first match wins).
D013: manager UI template lives outside both layouts/ and themes/. Manager is internal plumbing, not a themeable layout. (assets/ handled by the rule above.)
D022: registries source path now matches install destination. One rule replaces the previous rule-pair.
SM139 glue-deb vhost templates (lazysite-apache / lazysite-nginx): released with the tarball, never installed into a site tree.
Root-of-tarball docs including UPGRADE.md from 0.2.0 onwards.

runtime_paths.purpose: credentials, session secret, ACLs, consume lock, rate-limit DB - setgid + group-writable by the web user (www-data), no world access
runtime_paths.why: credential + session store; the CGI writes sessions and rate DBs, and nothing else may read it

runtime_paths.purpose: content backup tarballs - setgid + group-writable by www-data (Manager::Backups writes them through the CGI)
runtime_paths.why: the manager saves backup snapshots here; the installer used to create it with a bare make_path on upgrade, leaving it root-owned at the umask default so the manager's own backup action failed

runtime_paths.purpose: rendered HTML cache - setgid + group-writable by www-data (the CGI writes it), world-readable (Apache serves it)
runtime_paths.why: rendered page cache, written by the CGI on every miss

runtime_paths.purpose: application log output - setgid + group-writable by www-data
runtime_paths.why: engine + audit logs, appended by the CGI

runtime_paths.purpose: SM213 durable per-day visitor-stats rollups (aggregates only) - setgid + group-writable by www-data (the stats plugin writes it), not served publicly (under the protected lazysite/ tree)
runtime_paths.why: durable per-day visitor stats (SM213), written by the CGI

runtime_paths.purpose: per-file edit locks - setgid + group-writable by www-data
runtime_paths.why: edit locks, created and removed by the manager
plugin scripts, executed not written; no group write by design

runtime_paths.purpose: layouts + nested themes (D013) - setgid + group-writable by www-data (manage_layouts installs over the API)
runtime_paths.why: operator-installed layouts and themes; the manager writes here

runtime_paths.purpose: web-served theme assets (D013 nested under LAYOUT/THEME/) - setgid + group-writable by www-data (written on layout install)
runtime_paths.why: published theme asset mirror, written at activation
form-outcome log (SM216-2), counts only, written by the form handler
form config + submission store; the CGI appends submissions and it holds PII
content-history repository, created by the plugin at adoption - NOT created by the installer

runtime_files.why: the manager saves site navigation through the CGI; a 0644 file here fails nav-save with "Permission denied"
the manager and every conf writer save site settings through the CGI
the user store is rewritten by account operations run through the CGI
as auth/users - group membership and capability grants
per-file ACLs are written by the manager and the MCP/DAV surfaces
every surface APPENDS here; a 0644 file loses audit entries without trace

install_dirs.why: CGI scripts are executed by the web server, never written by it
the docroot IS the content tree - every authoring surface writes into it through the CGI. Normally pre-created by the platform; this mode applies only if the installer ever has to create it
the site root, holding engine code beside the docroot. Pre-created by the platform (on Hestia it is 0551 and the template hook makes it); this mode applies only at creation
site-level well-known documents are content; an agent may add one through the manager
uploads land here - the CGI creates files in this directory on every upload
engine documentation ships as ordinary pages in the content tree, and an operator may add or rename one
the engine's own state directory; the setgid pass already ORs 02020 onto it, and this is the same answer applied at creation instead of after the fact
the manager UI pages are content in the docroot and are refreshed on upgrade
engine modules - read and required, never written by the CGI
plugins are EXECUTED, not written - hardening this further is a legitimate operator choice
operator CLI tools - executed, never written by the CGI
